§ Helbah = "fertile"
a town of Asher, probably on the plain of Phoenicia not far from Sidon

§ Helbon = "fertile"
a town a few miles northwest of Damascus, modern 'Helbon', still noted for its fine grapes

§ Huldah = "weasel"
a prophetess in the time of Josiah whom Josiah asked for an authoritative opinion on the book of the law which Hilkiah found

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Zec.6.10; also called Helem at Zec.6.14; 
Also named: che.lem (חֵ֫לֶם "Helem" H2494)
§ Heldai = "worldly"
1) one of David's mighty warriors and the 12th captain of the monthly courses for the temple service
2) a returning exile in the time of Zechariah
